[[File:CRFG_components.jpg|thumb|right|A series of components in a modified tight-beam emitter including a pivar spinner]]
A '''pivar spinner''' was a component from a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]]. If fitted to a [[tight-beam emitter]], the pivar spinner could be modified to emit [[mag-particle]]s which could disrupt the command signals between a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] and its [[Droid caller/Legends|caller]].
